method: Current ATT Shadowlands crafted-item/reagent indexes identify candidates. Current Retail Wowhead item tooltips establish binding, spell tooltips establish exact batch/reagents, and individual pages/guide comments establish specialty sources. One verified recipe per output is loaded; lowest rank/no-cooldown is preferred where applicable. Full ingredients are preserved here, but vendor supplies are disclosed and omitted from the farmable component graph. Random milling/prospecting/card outputs have no deterministic single-result composition.

Source/tooltips establish recipe data; local fallback Lua verification is not in-game WoW verification.
Lattice coordinates are documented creature-search areas, not guaranteed spawn/drop points. Poultrid nests and lumber have no invented fixed positions.

Old Thieving Raptora instant-respawn tricks are reported as nerfed. No hyperspawn or realm-hopping dependency is encoded.
Twilight Bark is not ore or herb: it is a farmable Phaedrum byproduct with historical limited vendor stock. It is retained because it is not vendor-only and is required by housing recipes.
